title: heterotis buettneriana
intro: Heterotis buettneriana, commonly known as African henbane, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Africa. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Heterotis buettneriana include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to relieve pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include scopolamine, hyoscyamine, and other alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
